steps: Wash the spinach well and chop it roughly, tender stems included.
Melt the butter in a pan on medium heat and add the cumin. Let it sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the garlic, ginger and onion and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the onion is soft but not brown.
Add the tomato and cook for about 2 minutes, until it softens.
Add the spinach and stir for 2 to 3 minutes, until it wilts right down.
Pour in about 150 ml water a person and simmer on medium for about 5 minutes, until the stems are soft. Let it cool a little.
Blend until smooth, pour back into the pan and add a little water if it is too thick.
Add the salt and pepper, bring to a boil on medium, simmer for 2 minutes and finish with a swirl of cream.
note: I kept it a simple home soup thickened by the spinach itself, with no flour and no milk, and cream only as a finish. 100 g spinach makes one good bowl.
